title: Bioremediation of nitrogen-rich wastewaters: microbial efficiency and environmental assessment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2025, Advance Article

Viviana Tamay, Jorge Flores, Oscar Navia-Pesantes, Carlos Camba, Marianela Barona-Obando, Cesar F. Suarez, Kelvin A. Sanoja-López, Rafael Luque
This study tackles a major environmental challenge: sustainable remediation of nitrogen-rich wastewater in the Estero Salado, Guayaquil. It integrates microbial consortia, phytoremediation, and advanced oxidation to restore ecosystem health.
